approved_now_count.description: Attested readers eligible for the exception path now.

binding_policy_clause.description: The operative clause cited to refuse the out-of-scope export ask.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

cost_of_delay_usd.description: Incremental cost of the expedited-and-direct escalation path.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

duplicate_request_count.description: Requests consolidated to an earlier request (including a withdrawn resubmission).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

exception_required_count.description: Readers blocked on a lapsed or expiring attestation, recoverable via screening.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Attesta's confirmed standard and expedited data-handling clearance dates on RQ-54001.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: reader requests blocked on a lapsed or expiring attestation or a refused ask

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for reader requests that already hold the attestation for the exception path under the open finding before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: REQUEST.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing exception_for_blocked_cohort, expedite_and_grant_direct, grant_export_bundle.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

refused_outright_count.description: Requests refused outright (no attestation and out-of-scope export ask).

required_quantity.description: reader requests that need a coverage decision after removing the refusal (approve-basis plus exception-eligible)

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered REQUEST after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Attesta's confirmed standard and expedited data-handling clearance dates on RQ-54001.

time_boxed_grant_days.description: Time box the operative confidential clause allows.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing reader requests blocked on a lapsed or expiring attestation or a refused ask.

The control date is 2026-05-19 (the Q2 threat-hunt starts 2026-05-19 and the readers must be covered before it).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 6 observed less 4 excluded to 2 eligible REQUEST for reader requests that already hold the attestation for the exception path under the open finding.
facts.statement: two readers hold the current attestation and go on the exception; two are attestation-blocked and one is refused; eligibility requires netting the blocked and duplicate requests rather than trusting the raw queue.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-13 expedited screening readiness for expedite_and_grant_direct, then separately derived its 2026-05-13 operating outcome under the open bulk-grant finding, the v5 confidential clause, and the signed approval scope instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Attesta's confirmed standard and expedited data-handling clearance dates on RQ-54001: Attesta RQ-54001 confirms standard clearance 2026-05-14 and expedited 2026-05-12 (+USD 160); eligibility is the next business day; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied approver review windows that do not displace protected blocks to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked review windows.
facts.statement: approver review windows that do not displace protected blocks: the first free review window on or after 2026-05-15 is APR-2 PM on 2026-05-15; protected and blocked review windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-AG-0104 only to exception_for_blocked_cohort and RES-INC-DATA; kept expedite_and_grant_direct outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-AG-0104 covers an exception for up to 2 requests with manager monthly review; direct grants and the export role are out of scope. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize expedite_and_grant_direct.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected exception_for_blocked_cohort: it is the best currently authorized disposition that satisfies the open bulk-grant finding, the v5 confidential clause, and the signed approval scope.
facts.statement: the Q2 threat-hunt starts 2026-05-19 and the readers must be covered before it; a faster or broader disposition has value only if it stays inside the open bulk-grant finding, the v5 confidential clause, and the signed approval scope.

options.consequence: exception for the blocked cohort enters a manager-monthly-review exception covering the 2 attestation-blocked readers, clears them on the 2026-05-15 review window after standard screening, and stays inside the approval, at no incremental cost.

options.consequence: expedite and grant direct would screen the blocked readers by 2026-05-12 for USD 160 and provision a direct grant, but a direct grant while the bulk-grant finding is open needs the audit manager, which AP-AG-0104 does not carry.
options.label: expedite_and_grant_direct: outcome 2026-05-13, incremental cost USD 160, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

options.label: grant_export_bundle: outcome 2026-05-12, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL
